datasets.label: Verified prefix

scheme.convention: QQ period invariant basis exactly as stored in the cumulative ledger.
scheme.definition: X = Crit(P restricted to S_Y) = Spec C[S_Y] / (partial_a P)
scheme.distinction: The KLS scheme includes nilpotent structure. Its reduced support alone does not determine the jet or Macdonald series.

assumptions: The VOA is the simple affine algebra L_k(so(2n)) at k=-h^vee+h^vee/3.
The physical R-filtration is good: R(a_(j)b) <= R(a)+R(b)-1 for j>=0, and R(J)=1.
The top diagonal is the reduced Higgs ring of the stated orbit; lower-size Pfaffian minors are nonzero there.
Graded unitarity applies with Shapovalov sign (-1)^R on each homogeneous component; the compact real structure is used.
The bosonic affine sector has integral R; the filtration respects the orthogonal outer automorphism as well as the flavor group.
filtration_certificate.homogeneity_justification: At conformal degree n the determinant-character flavor singlet is uniquely the scalar Pfaffian: saturating all 2n indices requires n undifferentiated currents and the epsilon contraction. Thus it cannot mix different R components with the same symmetries. All displayed norms are nonzero, so these vectors survive the simple affine quotient.
filtration_certificate.norm_derivation: Repeated exact double-pole contractions give product_j(k+2j); invariance makes all perfect-matching contributions equal, giving the positive factor (2m-1)!!.

ope_checks.basis: A_ij=E_ij-E_ji, invariant form tr(AB)/2; current[1] is the double-pole product.
ope_checks.identity: J_01[1] Pf_4 = -(k+6) Pf_3 on the complementary indices
ope_checks.scope: One component; SO(2n) covariance gives the other Pfaffian-minor components.

ope_checks.basis: A_ij=E_ij-E_ji, invariant form tr(AB)/2; current[1] is the double-pole product.
ope_checks.identity: J_01[1] Pf_5 = -(k+8) Pf_4 on the complementary indices
ope_checks.scope: One component; SO(2n) covariance gives the other Pfaffian-minor components.

proof: The Pfaffians of order 3 are nonzero Higgs classes, so their R is 3.
J[1] acting on an order-4 Pfaffian gives a nonzero multiple of an order-3 Pfaffian. Goodness therefore forces R >= 3.
The order-4 Pfaffians vanish on the Higgs orbit, excluding R=4. Thus R=3.
J[1] acting on the scalar order-5 Pfaffian is nonzero, forcing R >= 3. The scalar vanishes on the Higgs branch, so R <= 4.
The exact norm has sign (-1)^3, excluding R=4. Thus the scalar Pfaffian also has R=3.
filtration_certificate.scope: Necessary physical grades under the stated assumptions; sufficiency of the completed filtration and the full index remain to be verified.

sources.scope: Good R-filtration and graded unitarity; the all-Casimir d-1 filtration is a trial proposal.

scheme.grading: Currents M: (1,1); trace W_d: (d,d-1); scalar Pfaffian W: (5,3); 45 Pfaffian covariants U: (4,3). A derivative adds (1,0).
scheme.graph: X_tilde: partial_a P = 0, C_d(M) - W_d = 0 (before taking jets). Pfaffian_(2n-2)(M) - U = 0 for every index subset; all graphs are differentiated before taking gr_T.
scheme.slice: S_Y = e + ker(ad f), with (e,h,f) an sl2 triple; S_0 = g.

datasets.scope: Complete QQ highest-weight source factors mapped into the actual Jacobian/graph jet ideal; joint target-T image ranks.; necessary Pfaffian grades conditional on the stored VOA/Higgs/good-filtration/unitarity assumptions; full physical identification is not proved.
